project.name: CARLOS
project.description: CARLOS EMR (Clinical Assisting Recording Ledger Open Source) is a web-based electronic medical record system for Canadian healthcare.

bannedDependencies.message: CARLOS routes Commons Logging through commons-logging:commons-logging to Log4j 2 (#5413). Exclude the banned artifact from the dependency that brings it in (mvn dependency:tree -Dincludes=GROUP:ARTIFACT shows the path); see the Logging section of pom.xml.
